philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: How XPChain is sustained and how the community operates
philosophy.purposeBody1: XPChain aims to remain an independent mainnet that accumulates records and trust over time.
philosophy.purposeBody2: We focus on building verifiable operational data and sustaining the network through participation.
philosophy.core1: Decentralization: Strengthen chain resilience and independence through broad node participation rather than control by a single actor.
philosophy.core2: Verifiability: Keep network status, APIs, release notes, and hashes publicly verifiable.
philosophy.core3: Long-term sustainability: Prioritize durable procedures and documentation over short-term events.
philosophy.transparency1: Major changes are documented with reasons and scope in release notes.
philosophy.transparency2: Consensus-impacting changes are explicitly separated and announced.
philosophy.transparency3: Wallet binaries are distributed with SHA-256 hashes and verification instructions.
philosophy.transparency4: Network and explorer status are displayed using measurable indicators.
philosophy.transparency5: Legacy documents are archived and differences from current standards are stated.
philosophy.communication1: Nothing on this site is investment solicitation.
philosophy.communication2: No guarantees are provided regarding returns, prices, or liquidity.
philosophy.communication3: Staking is presented as network participation, not as an investment product.
philosophy.communication4: Unverified information or speculation is not asserted as fact in official channels.
philosophy.services1: Most core development for SmartPig is complete, and XRoutine is in active development.
philosophy.services2: SmartPig XPC payment integration will follow Chrome extension payment UX updates.
philosophy.services3: XPChain is an independent network that is not tied to a single service and can connect multiple applications.

notices.title: Notices
notices.subtitle: Operational updates and change history.
items: Updated the web wallet and Chrome extension (v1.0.3) to link transactions to the primary explorer (explorer.xpchain.co.kr).
Improved wallet stability by fixing a rescanblockchain timeout that occurred on heavier wallets.
Patched all website dependency security vulnerabilities and strengthened defenses against bot/scanner traffic.
Officially launched the XPChain website. (ko/en/ja, Network/Wallets/Staking/Explorer/Docs live)
Completed Google Search Console and Naver Search Advisor registration with sitemap submission.
Applied locale-path rewrite for robots/sitemap to improve Naver crawler compatibility.
Aligned locale params handling for Next.js 16 and fixed runtime errors on docs/wallets/staking.
Completed XPC 1.0 technical series reflection on docs (Archive + organized edition).
Updated docs with v0.17.0-4 release verification results (macOS/Linux/Windows x64/x86 PASS).
Completed performance and loading UI improvements for blockchain explorer search/address lookup.
Published disclosure criteria for 'History + Current Operations Scope' on the docs page.
Migrated three whitepapers to server hosting and reorganized docs page.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Publicly sharing direction and execution items.
roadmap.directionBody: XPChain's roadmap is designed around network stability and long-term sustainability rather than short-term events.
direction1Items: Ongoing checks for block production stability
direction2Items: Strengthen Qt wallet maintenance and build reliability
Review improvements for UTXO management usability
direction4Items: Stabilize SmartPig operations and prepare payment integration
Continue XRoutine development with phased disclosure
Explore more use cases leveraging the network
roadmap.direction4Note: XPChain remains an independent network not bound to a single service.
direction5Items: Clearly distinguish and announce consensus changes
roadmap.directionSummary: Direction: prioritize stable operation and incremental improvement over rapid change.
roadmap.executionBody: Priorities below may be adjusted based on verification results and network status.
nowItems: Search indexing monitoring (Google/Naver index and robots/sitemap status)
nextItems: Finalize public Ubuntu node operation guide
Review and phase in structured data (JSON-LD)
laterItems: Finalize and apply seed infrastructure policy (seed1~seed3)
roadmap.disclaimer: This roadmap is an operations document and not investment guidance.
